name: ship-gate
description: Holds git push until a check has passed on exactly the content being pushed, and gh pr create until lizard --local approved it too. Pushes to main are held. /ship shows where you stand; /ship allow lets one through.

holdMainPush.title: Hold pushes to main
holdMainPush.description: Hold any git push that lands on the default branch (main or master).

requireLizard.title: Lizard before a PR
requireLizard.description: Hold gh pr create until lizard --local approved exactly the content being opened.

extraCheck.title: Extra check commands
extraCheck.description: A regular expression for repo-specific check commands that count as checks, e.g. node evals/static/validate\.mjs
